color.note: The eight hexes from the brand guidelines, the plant-based badge green, the logo's EST pink, then semantic tokens. Themes are grounds: Classic, Night, and one per Classic flavor bag.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Brand cream. The Classic ground (guidelines cards, founder letters), the 'LOUISVILLE' fill in the logo, and headline fill on flavor grounds. Navy text on cream is 11.5:1.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold. Smoky Carolina BBQ bag color, the 'JERKY' fill in the logo, the default CTA fill and the pop line in headlines. Navy text on gold is 8.5:1.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Buffalo Hot Wing bag color. Use as a flavor ground; navy text on orange is 5.9:1.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Maple Bacon bag color. Use as a flavor ground; navy text on pink is 8.8:1.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: General Tso's bag color, and the NON-GMO certification pill. Navy text on lavender is 5.5:1.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Pepperoni Pizza bag color and the sale burst. As a ground, set body text in ink-black (5.2:1); navy is only 4.3:1, so keep navy to 24px+ display type on red.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Smoked Black Pepper bag color, the 'CO.' in the logo, the flat sky logo card. Navy text on sky is 8.3:1.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy (#1E1A3B). Primary ink, the logo's 3D extrusion, outlines and hard shadows, and the Night ground. Cream text on navy is 11.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-black
tokens.usage: Near-black ink from the black logo version and the badge outlines. Hard shadows under CTAs and badges; body text on red.

tokens.name: leaf-green
tokens.usage: Plant Based badge green, also the green CTA (Cheddar Jalapeno email) and filled FlavorMeter segments. Navy text on it is 5.7:1.

tokens.name: est-pink
tokens.usage: The 'EST 2012' accent inside the logo and monogram. Accent only, never a ground or a text color for sentences.

tokens.name: flavor-smoked-black-pepper
tokens.usage: Smoked Black Pepper: the bag and FlavorTag color. An alias of sky, so the flavor always tracks the palette.

tokens.name: flavor-pepperoni-pizza
tokens.usage: Pepperoni Pizza: the bag and FlavorTag color. An alias of red, so the flavor always tracks the palette.

tokens.name: flavor-maple-bacon
tokens.usage: Maple Bacon: the bag and FlavorTag color. An alias of pink, so the flavor always tracks the palette.

tokens.name: flavor-general-tsos
tokens.usage: General Tso's: the bag and FlavorTag color. An alias of lavender, so the flavor always tracks the palette.

tokens.name: flavor-buffalo-hot-wing
tokens.usage: Buffalo Hot Wing: the bag and FlavorTag color. An alias of orange, so the flavor always tracks the palette.

tokens.name: flavor-smoky-carolina-bbq
tokens.usage: Smoky Carolina BBQ: the bag and FlavorTag color. An alias of gold, so the flavor always tracks the palette.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Section background. Each theme is one ground: Classic cream, Night navy, or a flavor's bag color. Scope a theme to one email section with data-theme on its wrapper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, letters and labels on ground. At least 5.2:1 on every theme's ground (ink-black on Pepperoni, navy on the other light grounds, cream on Night).

tokens.name: headline
tokens.usage: Primary headline fill: cream, like 'LOUISVILLE' in the logo. Always drawn with the edge outline (stroke-headline) and shadow-headline; the navy outline carries the contrast (cream on navy 11.5:1), so never set it without them. For an outline-free headline use the Headline plain variant, which fills with ink.

tokens.name: headline-pop
tokens.usage: Accent line in a two-tone headline (the 'ROAD STICK' line), like 'JERKY' in the logo: gold, or sky (the logo's 'CO.') on the gold Carolina BBQ ground. Display only, 28px+, always with the edge outline.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: CTA pill fill for this ground, taken from the campaigns: gold by default, sky on Pepperoni, green on Buffalo, navy on Maple Bacon and Carolina BBQ.

tokens.name: on-cta
tokens.usage: Label on the cta fill. At least 5.6:1 in every theme.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Outlines on headlines, badges, buttons and meter pills: navy on light grounds, ink-black on Night. Always at least 4.3:1 against the light grounds.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: Color of every hard offset shadow (buttons, badges, tags). Never a soft blur.

tokens.name: meter-empty
tokens.usage: Unfilled FlavorMeter segment, with an edge outline so it reads on every ground.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Anton, always UPPERCASE. Headlines, CTAs, badge and meter labels.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per email: the opening headline, two to three stacked lines.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section headlines further down an email.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Product names and small section heads.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Certification pills, meter labels, benefit captions.

groups.name: Flavor
groups.note: Docktrin, the vintage western face. Flavor names only.

styles.name: flavor-title
styles.usage: A flavor's name as a title, never a sentence. Set lowercase; Docktrin's lowercase is its clean caps.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: Gotham Pro Medium is the primary body face.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: The plant-based jerky stick that finally got the chew right.
styles.usage: The one-or-two-line deck under a hero headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bold smokehouse flavor, real pull, zero compromise.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Stacks with Jerky Coins and free shipping over $50.

groups.name: Letter
groups.note: Greycliff CF Bold carries the founder-letter emails.

styles.name: letter
styles.usage: Founder letters and first-person notes from Stanley.

styles.name: letter-sm
styles.sample: Grab a bag before they're gone!

spacing.note: 4px base; emails compose on the 8px steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and its icon.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside pills and badges; between stacked meter rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a headline and its deck.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs in a letter; badge row gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between a block of copy and its CTA.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Email side gutter; section top padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between email sections on the same ground.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero top padding under the logo.

radius.note: Chunky and friendly: rounded cards, full pills.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Meter segments and small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: FlavorTag tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Content cards, as on the guidelines sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: CTAs, certification pills, meter labels.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows only, never blurred: the brand's 3D-extruded logo, applied everywhere.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-sm
tokens.usage: Certification pills, meter labels, small tags.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: CTA buttons and FlavorTags.

tokens.name: shadow-block
tokens.usage: Cards and product panels that should feel extruded like the logo.

tokens.name: shadow-headline
tokens.usage: Text-shadow for Anton headlines, paired with a 3px edge outline.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on web surfaces: a solid 3px navy ring (gold on Night), at least 4.3:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: Button, badge and pill outlines in edge.

tokens.name: stroke-headline
tokens.usage: Text-stroke on Anton headlines (painted under the fill, so 3px shows).

tokens.name: email-width
tokens.usage: Every campaign is built at 600px wide (export 2x).

tokens.name: email-content
tokens.usage: Text column: email-width minus two space-6 gutters.

tokens.name: logo-width
tokens.usage: Header logo width in emails.
